author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
This is the new thread!
The old thread had a lot of requests, and this one is basically a fresh start to keep track of newer ones that are more relevant to the current Avicus maps, not ones from two years ago. Everything still applies.
Please read this thread entirely before posting.

This thread is for changes, not complete removals. If you have an issue with a map that warrants a removal, talk to a map developer privately about it. Do not suggest maps on this thread either, use the "Map Making" subforum.
- Please be as detailed as possible when creating such requests! No spam or joke replies, or they will be removed.

This thread is simple, you need something changed that you don't like in a map? Like maybe you want a monument to be moved or maybe a loadout to be changed? This is the place.

Format:
Map » example; Dust Devils
Change » example; move monument away from spawn
Reason » example; it's very hard to have to go through the spawn, and if you kill a defender they just turn around and kill you when they spawn
Anything Else » optional; anything that doesn't fit the above

Map Revisions: https://avicus.net/development/Maps

We will check this thread frequently, and will notify you via this thread or other means if your request has been granted.
